# Synthetic AI Image Detector (SAI)

> Production-reliability layer for detecting AI-generated images. Built for journalists, fact-checkers, and national-security analysts who cannot afford false accusations but also cannot afford to be fooled by deepfakes.

SAI is an open-source multi-signal detector that reports a calibrated probability, an uncertainty estimate, and a verdict that can refuse to commit when evidence is weak. Most open-source detectors publish a single score and call it a day. SAI adds the production-reliability primitives that real deployments need: temperature calibration, epistemic + aleatoric uncertainty, refusal verdicts, and a cross-generator evaluation harness that measures the new-generator failure mode.

## Evaluated on GenImage benchmark

- BigGAN vs Real: AUROC 0.9403
- ADM (diffusion) vs Real: AUROC 0.6634
- All generators (calibrated): AUROC 0.8019, ECE 0.1046
- Cross-generator: calibration does NOT transfer across generator families
- Refusal mechanism: 96.15% accuracy at 87% refusal rate

## Signals

1. **Frequency-domain** (DCT cross-channel correlation) - GAN generators leave periodic spectral artifacts
2. **Reconstruction error** (wavelet denoiser residual) - synthetic images reconstruct cleanly, real photos leave sensor noise residual
3. **Noise residual** (PRNU-style channel asymmetry) - real cameras leave Bayer-pattern fingerprints, AI generators do not

## Key files

- [README.md](README.md) - full project overview, results table, usage
- [docs/results.md](docs/results.md) - real-world evaluation writeup with limitations
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md) - design principles and signal pipeline
- [sai/pipeline.py](sai/pipeline.py) - ensemble detector with calibration and uncertainty
- [sai/calibration.py](sai/calibration.py) - temperature scaling + epistemic/aleatoric uncertainty
- [sai/eval.py](sai/eval.py) - evaluation harness with cross-generator generalization experiment
- [sai/cli.py](sai/cli.py) - CLI: `sai detect`, `sai eval-dir`, `sai calibrate`
- [scripts/run_real_eval.py](scripts/run_real_eval.py) - reproducible GenImage evaluation
- [scripts/download_eval_data.py](scripts/download_eval_data.py) - HuggingFace dataset download

## Install

```bash
pip install -e .
sai detect path/to/image.png
sai eval-dir real_dir/ ai_dir/ --generator biggan
```
